protection.help: what the frame(s) guaranteed: clear, auth_unverified (an authenticated SA, MAC not checked yet), enc, auth or authenc (checked by the crypto backend). A packet that spans frames gets the weakest

spi.help: Security Association protecting the frame(s) the packet came in

vcid.help: virtual channel the packet arrived on

asm.help: sync marker before each frame, as hex; empty when frames arrive one per datagram, already aligned

value_help.none: nobody: authenticated frames stay auth_unverified, encrypted frames unreadable

encrypted_without_backend.help: frames of encrypting SAs, which cannot be read without the crypto backend

frame_counter_gap.help: a frame whose virtual channel frame count skipped (frames lost, injected or replayed)

value_help.warn: accept it and count the gap

frame_length.help: bytes per frame, without the sync marker

has_ocf.help: the OCF flag every frame must have

max_forward_jump.help: how far a sequence number or IV may jump ahead of the last accepted one. Set it at least as high as the block the spacecraft reserves when it saves its counters

replay_baseline.help: when there is no last accepted counter for an SA

value_help.learn: accept the first frame and remember its counter
value_help.require: reject until an admin sets a floor (Reset counter)

scid.help: spacecraft ID every frame must carry

secondary_header.help: the secondary header flag every frame must have

security_associations.help: by SPI; the field lengths must match the spacecraft's SAs

iv_len.help: IV field bytes in the header

max_forward_jump.help: this SA's limit on how far the counter may jump ahead (default: the link's)

mode.help: what the SA does to the frame

pl_len.help: pad length field bytes in the header

replay.help: anti-replay counter (default: sn when the SA has a sequence number, else iv for encrypting SAs with an IV, else none)

value_help.iv: the IV must increase (GCM counter IVs)

sn_len.help: sequence number (ARSN) field bytes in the header

untrust_on_first_frame_reject.help: when the first frame has the wrong spacecraft ID, virtual channel, SPI or layout, discard everything until the interface reconnects or an admin restores trust. Corrupted frames, replays and counter gaps never count
untrust_on_first_frame_reject.title: Distrust the connection if its first frame is rejected

unverified_auth.help: frames of authenticated SAs whose MAC no crypto backend checked

value_help.allow: pass them on as auth_unverified (rules can still deny)

verified_forward.help: counter jumps on frames whose MAC the crypto backend verified

value_help.any: accept any increase (only a key holder can forge one)

virtual_channels.help: by VCID: frames on any other virtual channel are rejected

spi.help: SPIs allowed to protect this virtual channel

schema.help: How the spacecraft frames and protects telemetry on this interface. The security associations must match the spacecraft's.
